verses: To the chief Musician for strings, A Maskil of David,
when the Zifim came and said to Sha᾽ul, Does not David hide himself with us?
Save me, O God, by Thy name, and judge me by Thy strength.
Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
For strangers are risen up against me, and violent men seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. (Sela.)
Behold, God is my helper: the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
He rewards evil to my enemies: O, cut them off in Thy truth.
I will sacrifice a free will offering to Thee: I will praise Thy name, O Lord; for it is good.
For he has delivered me out of all trouble: and my eye has gazed upon my enemies.
